A Special Visit from a Pet Owner! 🐶🐱

Our little learners had a wonderful and interactive experience as a pet owner visited our preschool and introduced them to the world of pets. 🐾❤️

The children learned about different kinds of pets, their food, habits, daily care, and the importance of treating animals with love and kindness. They were excited to listen to interesting stories and learn about responsible pet ownership. 🥰

The visit encouraged our little ones to be gentle, caring, and compassionate towards animals. It was a fun-filled learning experience that created many happy memories for our young animal lovers! 🌈🐕🐾

Little Hearts, Big Kindness: Our Playgroup Volunteers Visit an Old Age Home
Some of the best lessons don't happen in a classroom. Recently, our playgroup's young volunteers visited [Seva old age home] to spend time with its residents. It was a small outing that meant a great deal.
The children arrived carrying baskets of fresh fruit. Each child handed a share to the residents, some shyly, some with big grins, and all with the kind of sincerity only little ones have. The elders' faces lit up as tiny hands offered them bananas, apples and oranges 
What touched everyone most wasn't the gift itself but the warmth around it. The children sat beside the residents, greeted them with folded hands and cheerful "hellos", and listened as the elders shared stories and blessing.
For our children, the visit was a gentle introduction to empathy: to notice others, to share what they have, and to understand that elders deserve our time, respect and affection. For the residents, it was a reminder that they are loved and remembered.
We are proud of our young volunteers and grateful to the parents, teachers and staff at [Seva old age home ] who made the day possible. Small acts of kindness, it turns out, can bring big joy to both the giver and the receiver.
Because when little hands give with a full heart, they teach us all what compassion looks like.

A Fun and Educational Visit to Divine Fresh! 🌱

Our little learners had a wonderful and enriching field visit to Divine Fresh, where they got an exciting opportunity to learn about the production of sprouts.

The children were introduced to the fascinating journey of how tiny seeds transform into nutritious sprouts. They observed the different stages involved in sprout production and learned about the importance of water, cleanliness, care, and proper growing conditions.

Through this hands-on experience, our young explorers understood how healthy food reaches our tables and developed a greater appreciation for fresh and nutritious foods. The visit encouraged curiosity, observation, and learning beyond the classroom.

It was a delightful experience filled with discovery, excitement, and valuable real-world learning for our little ones! 🌱✨
A heartfelt thank you to the Divine Fresh team for patiently guiding our children and making the visit so informative and memorable. 💚

Rainbow Salad Making 🌈

Today, our little chefs had lots of fun making a Rainbow Salad! 🥕🍎🥒🍇

The children explored colourful fruits and vegetables and learned that eating different colours can help us stay healthy and strong. They identified the colours, touched and smelled the ingredients, and helped mix them together to make a delicious rainbow in a bowl.

The activity encouraged children to:

🌈 Recognise different colours🍎 Identify fruits and vegetables🥗 Develop healthy eating habits🤲 Improve fine motor skills through mixing and arranging😊 Enjoy learning through hands-on play

Teachers’ Day Celebration

Teachers’ Day was celebrated with great joy and enthusiasm at our preschool. The day was a wonderful opportunity for our little ones to express their love, gratitude, and appreciation towards their teachers.
The celebrations began with cheerful greetings and a warm welcome for the teachers. Our young learners participated in a variety of fun-filled activities, including songs, dances, games, and creative performances. Their innocent smiles and enthusiastic participation made the celebration truly special.
The children also presented handmade cards and thoughtful little gifts to their teachers as a token of love and appreciation. These simple gestures brought immense happiness to the teachers and created beautiful memories for everyone.

Krishna Janmashtami Celebration at Our Preschool 🌸

Our preschool celebrated Krishna Janmashtami with great joy, enthusiasm, and devotion. The celebration was a wonderful opportunity for our little ones to learn about the birth of Lord Krishna and experience the beauty of our rich Indian culture and traditions.
The children came dressed as little Krishnas and Radhas, filling the school with smiles and vibrant colours. Their adorable costumes, beautiful decorations, and cheerful faces made the celebration truly special.
The children enjoyed a variety of fun and meaningful activities, including Krishna-themed songs, dances, storytelling, colouring, and craft activities. They also learned about Krishna’s childhood stories and his playful love for butter, making the learning experience both enjoyable and memorable.
